title: pi-agent settings
description: Non-secret CLI defaults. Session defaults apply to new sessions; resume retains journaled configuration. Runtime validation additionally checks cross-field and filesystem constraints.

$schema.description: Editor schema reference; ignored by the runtime and never fetched.

model.description: Model identifier sent to the provider.

base_url.description: Provider API root. Credentials, query strings and fragments are not supported.

http_timeout.description: HTTP inactivity timeout in seconds, not a whole-run deadline.

thinking_level.description: Requested reasoning level, checked against model capabilities.

thinking_level_map.description: Optional explicit native effort map. Missing or null levels are unsupported; at least one level must be supported. Persisted with model identity.

context_window.description: Known context window in tokens; omit when unknown.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per response, also bounded by estimated available context.

compaction.description: History compaction thresholds; these do not cap summary output.

retry.description: Bounded transient-error retries for conversation and summary requests.

bash_default_timeout_s.description: Default Bash timeout in seconds; null leaves it unset.

max_parallel_tools.description: Maximum admitted concurrent tool calls in parallel mode.

permissions.description: Admission policy, not an OS sandbox. Replaces the whole lower-priority policy.

tools.description: Absolute builtin selection for new sessions. An empty list disables builtins; relative edits belong in CLI --tools.

skills.description: Trusted Markdown skill discovery and prompt budget.

chat_template_kwargs.description: OpenAI-compatible template arguments. SGLang enable_thinking follows the selected level.

reserve_tokens.description: Start compaction when context exceeds window minus this reserve.

keep_recent_tokens.description: Approximate recent history retained after compaction.

max_delay_ms.description: Backoff cap in milliseconds; must be at least base_delay_ms.

read_only.description: Allow only read and verified builtin search tools.

rules.description: First matching rule wins, subject to read_only.

path.description: Optional path glob; parent traversal components are rejected.

reason.description: Optional explanation shown to the caller.

enabled.description: Enable skills in new CLI sessions; the core SDK defaults to false.

prompt_max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes for the skills prompt section.
